# Random genomes over the resource, movement, donation, messaging, energy,
# group and kaboom/promoter instruction families, traced by the C++
# reference (cbuild/work/avida -a, analyze LOAD_SEQUENCE... + TRACE
# trace_out/ 0 0 <random>, i.e. resources at their update-0 levels) with
# the tests/fixtures/res_env config and the instruction set given per batch.
# SEQ <sequence> <fnv1a64 of the trace> <trace length in bytes>
# Each batch adds a common core (if-n-equ ... h-search) to one family.
# Left out: sense-quorum, noisy-quorum, check-lyse, sense-autoinducer
# (GetCell(-1) in a test CPU; Err in Rust); relinquishEnergyTo*Organisms*
# (the reference segfaults printing the dead organism's trace footer);
# get-neighbors-reputation (the reference build calls FindModifiedRegister
# before its neighbour check, unlike 47f13dadb).
# The reference also segfaults now and then (depending on ASLR) in
# ~cOrganism -> ~Property when CommandTrace drops a test organism, after
# that organism's trace is complete; the hashes come from runs that
# finished all 30 traces with exit status 0, which are identical.
